title: apply result
description: What a successful apply returns. exec and recipe return the same fields plus their own. A rejected batch returns error.schema.json instead.

batch.description: This batch's ID. Pass it to revert to undo exactly this batch.

ids.description: IDs Reflex generated or changed, keyed by op position, such as {"ops[2]": "note-1"}. Use these IDs from now on.

repaired.description: Mistakes Reflex fixed for you, one line each. The batch was applied with the fix.

lints.description: Problems with how the result looks, such as text covering a person's Ink. The batch was applied anyway.

look.description: Only when the call set look: true. The rendered crop follows this JSON as image 1.

code.description: A stable code, such as overlaps_ink, overlaps, endpoint_unattached, text_overflow, off_canvas or low_contrast.
